cases.sentence: Он был в положении человека, отыскивающего пищу в игрушечных и ___.
cases.explain: «оружейных лавках» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: He was in the position of a man seeking food in toy shops and tool shops.

cases.sentence: Но прошла эта минута, и он не мог дать этому ___ никакого места в своей жизни.
cases.explain: «тогдашнему настроению» — the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: Moreover, during his wife’s confinement, something had happened that seemed extraordinary to him. He, an unbeliever, had fallen into praying, and at the moment he prayed, he believed. But that moment had passed, and he could not make his state of mind at that moment fit into the rest of his life.

cases.sentence: Он был в ___ с самим собою и напрягал все душевные силы, чтобы выйти из него.
cases.explain: «мучительном разладе» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: He could not admit that at that moment he knew the truth, and that now he was wrong; for as soon as he began thinking calmly about it, it all fell to pieces. He could not admit that he was mistaken then, for his spiritual condition then was precious to him, and to admit that it was a proof of weakness would have been to desecrate those moments. He was miserably divided against himself, and strained all his spiritual forces to the utmost to escape from this condition.

cases.sentence: Он был в мучительном разладе с самим собою и напрягал все ___, чтобы выйти из него.
cases.explain: «душевные силы» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: He could not admit that at that moment he knew the truth, and that now he was wrong; for as soon as he began thinking calmly about it, it all fell to pieces. He could not admit that he was mistaken then, for his spiritual condition then was precious to him, and to admit that it was a proof of weakness would have been to desecrate those moments. He was miserably divided against himself, and strained all his spiritual forces to the utmost to escape from this condition.
